title: chant-gate-statement/v1
description: What `chant approve <op> <gate> --statement` prints (#4646): the exact bytes an approval of the gate signs, for a signature made outside chant. Sign `statement` (the bytes of `text`) with an ssh key in the `chant-gate` namespace, or with a passkey whose WebAuthn challenge is `challenge`, then record it with `chant approve <op> <gate> --actor <resolvedBy> --at <timestamp> --signature <file>`, passing the same `--relayed-by`, `--plan` and `--env`. Written by chant 0.124.63 and newer. Readers ignore fields they do not know; a field is only ever added within a version.

chantVersion.description: The chant that printed the statement.

op.description: The Op, or the component or command name the gate is recorded under. The statement's first line.

environment.description: The environment the approval answers; null signs an empty third line.

planDigest.description: The plan the approval is for; null signs an empty fourth line.

resolvedBy.description: The approver, as --actor names them: the principal the signature must be listed for at base. The fifth line.

relayedBy.description: Who relays the approval (--relayed-by). When not null the statement has a `relayed-by <principal>` line after the time.

timestamp.description: The approval's time, ISO 8601 UTC with milliseconds. The sixth line. Pass it as --at when recording the signature.

checkpointDigest.description: The checkpoint a resumed run carries its outputs from. When not null the statement ends with a `checkpoint <digest>` line.

sealVersion.description: 2 when the statement signs a checkpoint digest, else 1.

namespace.description: The ssh signature namespace (`ssh-keygen -Y sign -n chant-gate`).

text.description: The statement as UTF-8 text: the lines joined by LF, no final newline.

statement.description: The same bytes, base64. These are what is signed.

challenge.description: The WebAuthn challenge a passkey signs: base64url of the bytes' SHA-256, with no padding.
